up: Find all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1255382. For each compound, return the compound's ChEMBL ID, its preferred name (pref_name), its maximum development phase (max_phase), its molecule type (e.g., Small molecule, Antibody, etc.), and its canonical SMILES. Order the results by the compound ChEMBL ID in ascending order. If a compound appears multiple times in the document, include it only once. Only include compounds that have a canonical SMILES entry.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1255382' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
